name: New Scrapped Assets List
query:
select distinct t1.voucher_no, t1.voucher_type, t1.against_voucher 'Asset',
				t1.cost_center,
				t1.posting_date
			from `tabGL Entry` t1
			inner join `tabAccount` a on a.name = t1.account
			where t1.posting_date between '2026-07-01' and '2026-07-31'
			and t1.cbs_enabled = 1
			and t1.is_cancelled = 0
			and t1.voucher_no in (
				select asst.journal_entry_for_scrap
				from tabAsset as asst
				where asst.disposal_date between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and asst.docstatus=1
			)
			and not exists(select 1
				from `tabCBS Entry Upload` ceu
				where ceu.gl_entry = t1.name
				and ceu.docstatus != 2)
		order by posting_date, voucher_type, voucher_no
